raw.rationale: Clofazimine is a lipophilic riminophenazine that accumulates in lysosomes and mitochondria, causing broad, non-lineage-specific cytotoxicity at 2.5 µM rather than selective killing; PRISM-type screens show only weak, sporadic lineage selectivity, so probabilities are near the low base rate with minor elevation for skin (leprosy/Mycobacterium-related and melanin/lysosome biology) and lung (known clofazimine accumulation/activity).
